insight: Open-sourced by Alibaba's Tongyi Lab under Apache 2.0, with weights, training, and inference code all public.
name: Wan
tagline: Open-source text- and image-to-video generation from Alibaba.
description: Wan is an open-source family of video generation models from Alibaba's Tongyi Lab, covering text-to-video, image-to-video, and image generation and editing. Released under Apache 2.0 with weights, training, and inference code public, it can be self-hosted or used free on the wan.video site. Successive versions, including Wan 2.2's mixture-of-experts architecture, have topped open-video benchmarks.

modelSupport.notes: Open-weight video models; runnable locally or via the hosted site and API.

edge: A fully open (Apache 2.0) video model you can self-host or run free online, matching closed models like Sora on the VBench benchmark.
pros: Self-host or use free at wan.video
